- Overestimate prices when sentiment is positive (especially >0.67) and understate when sentiment is negative (especially <0.33).  
- Overshoot after recent spikes in price — reduce forecast peak by 5–10% if sentiment is bullish but price recently surged.  
- Underreact to strong negative sentiment — if sentiment drops below 0.33, lower forecast mean by 2–5% to avoid overcorrection.  
- Mean-revert toward recent 18-day average if sentiment is neutral or mixed (0.33–0.67) and forecast is drifting far from history.  
- Avoid over-optimism in 30-day horizon — if sentiment is weak or mixed, cap forecast at 10% below recent 18-day high.  
- Lag correction: if sentiment is rising, delay peak forecast by 1–2 days; if falling, anticipate early dip and adjust downward.
